title: LOGOS ASF — Training Source Registry
description: Constitutional data contract governing which sources may enter the Abigail training pipeline. No source may enter TR-04B unless it is present here with registry_status=approved, the requested use is listed in allowed_uses, hp_decision_status=approved, a sha256_manifest is present, and a clearance ledger entry exists (TR-04A.4, not implemented in this file).

registry_id.description: Stable identifier for this registry instance.

version.description: Semantic version of this registry document.

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which this registry version became authoritative.

authority.description: Human Principal who owns and authorizes this registry.

constitutional_constraint.description: Binding statement of what this registry enforces. Must be preserved verbatim across versions.

entries.description: Ordered list of registered training data sources. Each entry represents one source evaluated for pipeline eligibility.

SourceEntry.description: A single registered training data source with its clearance posture, provenance, and allowed-use declaration.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for this source. Format: L<lane>-<NNN>.

source_type.description: Machine-readable category describing the origin and format of this source.

lane.description: Trust lane (1=fully owned, 7=maximum scrutiny/experimental). Determines default clearance posture and operator approval requirements.

commercial_use_allowed.description: Whether the license explicitly permits commercial use.

requires_attribution.description: Whether using this source requires attribution to the original author or publisher.

sharealike_risk.description: Whether this source carries a share-alike (copyleft) risk that could affect derivative works.

no_derivatives_risk.description: Whether this source carries a no-derivatives restriction that could affect training use.

pii_risk.description: Assessed PII exposure risk of this source.

copyright_risk.description: Assessed copyright clearance risk of this source.

registry_status.description: Current lifecycle status of this source in the registry. Only 'approved' sources may enter TR-04B.

allowed_uses.description: Exhaustive list of pipeline uses permitted for this source. A source may only be used for a purpose that appears here. Blocked sources must declare an empty list.

hp_decision_status.description: Human Principal decision status. 'approved' is required before any source enters TR-04B.

hp_decision_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the Human Principal decision. Null if pending or not yet decided.

license_evidence_uri.description: URI or reference document evidencing the license determination. May be a file path, URL, or descriptive reference.

license_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent license review. Null if review has not occurred.

license_checked_by.description: Identifier of the reviewer who performed the license check. Null if not yet reviewed.

component_whitelist.description: For composite or synthetic sources: list of source_ids that may serve as inputs. Empty for non-composite sources.

drift_risk_level.description: Risk that content in this source could cause behavioral drift in a trained model.

requires_operator_approval.description: Whether each individual use of this source requires explicit operator approval beyond the standing registry approval.

sha256_manifest.description: SHA-256 manifest string or sentinel value for the source artifact bundle. Must be replaced with a real content hash before TR-04B ingestion. 'PENDING_SOURCE_MANIFEST' is accepted at registration time only.

govmem_namespace.description: GovMem/skill-forge namespace path where provenance and clearance records for this source are stored.

notes.description: Free-text governance notes. Should include handling constraints, known risks, and any conditional approval details.

synthetic_origin.description: Required for entries with source_type=synthetic_instruction_data. Indicates that this source was generated rather than collected.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the prompt template(s) used to generate this synthetic source. Required for concrete synthetic output batches. Null at registry seed declaration stage.

generation_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or pipeline that generated this synthetic source. Required for concrete synthetic output batches. Null at registry seed declaration stage.

x-invariants.tr04b_requires_approved_status: No source may enter TR-04B unless registry_status=approved.
x-invariants.tr04b_requires_allowed_use: No source may enter TR-04B unless the requested use is listed in allowed_uses.
x-invariants.tr04b_requires_hp_approval: No source may enter TR-04B unless hp_decision_status=approved.
x-invariants.tr04b_requires_sha256_manifest: No source may enter TR-04B unless sha256_manifest is a real SHA-256 content hash (not a sentinel value).
x-invariants.tr04b_requires_clearance_ledger_entry: No source may enter TR-04B unless a clearance ledger entry exists. Ledger implementation is TR-04A.4 (not created in this file).
x-invariants.blocked_sources_have_empty_uses: Sources with registry_status=blocked must declare allowed_uses as an empty array.
x-invariants.synthetic_must_label_origin: Sources with source_type=synthetic_instruction_data must include synthetic_origin=true.
x-invariants.lane_integrity: source_id prefix L<N> must match the lane field value.
